scope: Standalone pixel equivalence and median kernel wall time; not full estimator CPU savings.
status: pixel equivalence verified; CPU savings measured on two sequences; quality-preserving selection unproven
image_list_selection: 160 native V1_01_easy grayscale images sampled across the sequence, each checked with both rectification maps.
additional_checks: source dimensions down to one pixel

kernel_timing.limits: Console durations rounded; percentages calculated within the check before formatting. Kernel timing excludes plan creation and is not process CPU.

fallback_build: All identical pixel checks passed without AVX2; timings are not claimed as savings.
limits: Only immutable owned maps are cached. API falls back for other versions, processors, layouts or overlapping buffers. The hardware splitter already rectifies images, so this System change does not speed the current tower configuration.
